learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to beautifully group, overlap, and draw everyday objects together like a real artist!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Composition is like a magical recipe for your drawing! It means deciding exactly where to place your objects on the paper so they look balanced and beautiful together.
Instead of drawing things far apart, artists place objects close to each other. Grouping makes your drawing look like a happy family of objects having a little party!
When you place a small toy in front of a tall bottle, the toy hides a little part of the bottle. This trick is called overlapping, and it makes your art look real and 3D!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My First Still Life Masterpiece!
fun_activity.instructions: Gather your favorite toy, a yummy fruit, and a shiny cup. Arrange them on a table so some parts overlap, and draw exactly what you see with your bright crayons!

quick_recap: ⭐ Artists always look carefully and arrange their objects before drawing.
⭐ Overlapping things makes your picture look real and popping out of the page!
⭐ A beautiful arrangement or composition brings all the objects together in a fun way.
